title: Pagosa Springs History Museum

services.name: Metal Art Exhibit
services.desc: of an eagle sculpture by welder, teacher and community leader Worthe Crouse. This is just one of the art pieces by Mr. Crouse on display at the museum. Metal art by Worthe Crouse is a part of the blacksmith exhibit. Pieces include an eagle perched on a rock with a fish in its grip, an elephant, columbine, coral and more. Mr. Crouse was one of the founding members of the historical society. At the first meeting of citizens interested in preserving area history, he was elected president of the newly formed society.
